Do we accomplish more by constantly doing something? Thomas Jefferson wrote, "Determine never to be idle... It is wonderful how much may be done if we are always doing." He believed that more would be accomplished if there was something being done most of the time, I agree with this. Accomplishing a task motivates some people to do more, accomplishing more, It also helps us learn more about ourselves. Although, people believe that being in-active is better because it provides less stress and more free time, It also keeps us from succeeding our daily tasks and influences us to be lazy.

Being busy would require us to be awake and alert of what we are doing. In some cases, after finishing up a task, all people want to do is move on and rest. In other cases, people choose to knock out more work that they have in mind. Having this kind of mindset it good, because it allows a person to have more energy and to keep themselves busy. A personal experience would be when I was so tired one afternoon, but I had to keep myself from napping because I had homework due. After I completed that one homework, I was too awake to even sleep; So I decided to knock out other work I had in the meantime. Everyone has a different way of living and learning, and keeping myself busy taught me a lot about how I live and learn.

Although being in active provides us with less stress and more free time, which is not always a bad thing, It influences us to not only be more lazy, but to procrastinate. Procrastination can lead you to become more and more unprepared. Being unprepared isn't the best way to live. Having more free time can have it's positive outcomes, but also its negatives. For example, who wants to accomplish nothing now, only to do the same in the future? People may believe being in-active is a better way to live because it relieves you from stress and work, but doing nothing can follow with other bad habits that can lead to worse in your future.

In conclusion, we accomplish more by keeping busy. Keeping ourselves busy can help us prepare for our future, and help us learn more about ourselves and how to respond to a hectic lifestyle. Although some people would like to live a lifestyle doing absolutely nothing, that wouldn't be the case for all. Others would prefer to accomplish more by staying active and helping themselves prepare for whatever comes next.

In certain societies, students of young age are required to identify a career by the time they enter high school. However, others may believe that this will bring too much stress and pressure on 14 year old students, that is expected to pick a career when they are not a hundred percent sure. Schools should just stay with the required core classes, and if a student wishes to join a class where they give more attention to their career, they may. Students in high school should not be expected to take courses that guide the students to a specific career, because young students are not sure of what they want to pursue and specific courses can be too stressful for a young mind.

These young students should not be forced to identify a career in the eighth grade. The school faculty should not expect upcoming freshmen to know what they would like to pursue in the future and to take courses that guide them towards that career. These students can change their minds, at any moment in their years at high school. As a child one would want to be: a singer, a doctor, an astronaut, or a race car driver, these are all realistic career choices. But as one grows up one can change their mind and starts to find new interests, one becomes more mature about their future. For example, an average student can say they want to be a writer and then decide after a year now they want to be a teacher. Many things in ones life can impact what one's career will be like teachers, parents, role models, and oneself. Many students do not usually know what they would like to pursue till like junior or senior year, it is a choice that is made as you grow up.

The specific courses, that are given can be very stressful for a young mind. Having a high school student come to school to study toward a specific career everyday can be stressful. Many students also have special commendations and will seek more attention than others or will need extra time with schoolwork. Many students also do after school circulars, which can add even more stress to those students. For certain careers, students may be required to take a high level of math or an AP class. For example, if a student would like to pursue a career in electric engineering they may need to take calculus and an engineering class, not adding the fact that the student will still need to take their core classes. These courses can be very stressful depending on the young mind, everyone learns in a different way.

In conclusion, high schools should not expect students of young age to know what career they want to pursue and have them take courses. This expectations can cause students to force themselves to choose a career and be overly stressed. However, the courses can prepare the students for college and their future career. The courses can also help the student understand their career choice in more depth. The courses can lead you to a bright future. The schools that require the students to identify a career are just helping the young minds of today go the right direction.

I believe that this has led to a positive effects on our lives. For example: before we used to have a difficult time contacting people from far away, but with social media and smart phones we can easily have a contact with people from the other side of the world. Technology has changed the way we contact with other human beings, but in the other hand makes it much more easier to do so.

Technology has changed the meaning of the word "contact" forever, now we have a new way to communicate and get in touch with other people. Why working together is more beneficial than working alone? Working with group of people increase collaboration and allows brainstorming. As a result, more ideas are developed and productivily improves. Working together prepare students for future jobs and careers. Two or more people are always better than one for solving problems. However, it is an importan skill to be able to get along with others and it is valued by employers.

Everyone has heard people saying "Two minds are better than one" This quote has never rang more true, and all of the ideas it promotes reflect crystal clear off a group work. Working in a group can reduce the amount of work you need to do, as well as make things a lot more efficient. Things are also finished much quicker because of the way many people can split up different jobs in a group, and people with differents skill sets can do what they're best at. This broader range of skills can also be used to help other group members. The diversity found within a group of people is one of the most powerful resources a person can have when it comes to finishing a task.

Though multiple ideas are helpful, and it is less work to be in a group. Sometimes working alone is beneficial as well. It really depends on the circumstances you're placed in, and the people you are around to say wether or not working in a group is benign or unremunerative. Though working alone can be better for one's own reasons, such as anxiety, paranoia, worry about others preferences, or simply because you prefer to work alone. Oftentime students will learn and experience more in group of their peers than working alone, which is better for the futures and possibly what lies ahead.

Working together creates less work and allows more work to be completed faster. It allows constructive criticism from other members of the group, which promotes a better final product in the end. Overall, working together is beneficial because it creates differents points, new ideas are generated. Different points of view create divesity and diversity is the key to success.

Summer is the time for students to take a break from school, but some educators feel that summer break is too long and it needs to be shorten. As for me, I am strongly disagree with this idea because summer is the time for student to visit their famiy, their relatives, to do whatever they like, to enjoy whatever they love and sometimes learning too much might be somthing that some students could not handle.

First of all, summer is the time for students to come back to their hometown to visit their family. Some students, like me, came from another country so a lot of times we do miss our hometown. That is why having a three month summer break is truly a huge chance for us because that is pretty much the only reunion we have in a year. I will take mine as an example. To be able to come back to Generic_City it is not just about time, sometimes it could involve money. The ticket is just too expensive, not to mention that it is in summer. So if I can visit my family this year, I might have to wait a few years later to be able to visit them again.

Secondly, this is a period of time where students can do whatever thay want to do like doing some volunteering or club activities or playing sports or just simply doing their favorite hobbies. If we shorten the summer break, students will easily get bored when they come back to school because they do not have enough time to do what they like in summer. Nobody wants to study when they are bored. So if we want a student to return to school with lots of energy, we need to let them have a break. And that give me an example. One of my Vietnamese friend told me that even in summer he still have to take a lot of tutor classes. That is why if we shorten the summer break then lots and lots of Asian students will not even have time to do what they love!

Last but not least, learning too much might be something that some students could not handle. A short summer break meaning we have to go to school more than we need. I know that if we shorten the summer break we will have a longer winter break, but that is not the case for the country that does not have a winter break or a week off in fall and spring. A student could get stress if they do not have a proper break. Just check some examples on the news or internet, especially in South Korea or Japan. A lot of students suicide just because of learning too much. Too many homeworks and tests, pressures from parents and teacher,.... Very stressful! Not to mention that Asian students usually have a shorter summer break and winter break.

On the whole, I am not agree with this idea and along with fact that I am an Asian and I used to go through a very strict and tough education in Asia, I can never accept this. Students need to have some times to release their stress after a long year at school by visiting their family or doing whatever they like.

People who value self-reliance define it as the need for each individual to follow his or her own instincts and ideas. There is a quote that says, "If you want to go fast go by yourself, but if you want to far go with someone else". As the quote says, I think that it's very important to have someone to guide us throughout the course of our lives. I agree that seeking for guidance from experts to make wise decisions can have a great impact in our lives. Experts and authorities can provide us with advices to make good decisions in life and accomplish our goals more easily.

First of all, having someone to guide you throughout the decisions you make in life could help you accomplish a goal a lot easier. For example, when I was in middle school I used to think that doing individual work was faster and easier. However, I noticed that most of my classmates who worked in groups finished all the assignments in less time than I did. This experience showed me the importance of always having someone to give you their opinion to accomplish a goal quickly and avoid wasting your time. Thus, seeking for guidance from experts can help you achieve any goal you set in life and avoid wastig your time on making wrong decisions.

In addition, you will learn and gain experience if you have someone expert to guide you. For example, having an expert guiding you will allow you to see his different points of view and learned from his teachings. This will allow you to learn from his teachings and experiences and reflect about them. Furthermore, relying on with an expert will give you the chance to learn new lessons and in the future give you the opportunity to make your own decisions. Finally,

you will learn how to make wise choices by learning from the lessons that an expert or authority could offer you.

Some people say that having someone telling you what to do will limit you from choosing what's best for you. For instance, when I was 10 years old I really wanted to make my own decisions that I thought were best for me. In whatever manner, I rarely got to choose my own decisions because my brother was always there telling what decisions to make. As I grew older I understood that my brother was just guiding me through the right path. Because my brother had experienced many of the situations I went through, he was able to help me and in many occasions avoid me from failing. Therefore, experts and authorities will be there to not let you fail and always look for what's best for you.

In conclusion, seeking from guidance from experts may not give you the freedom to make your own decisions, but it will help you accomplish your goals rapidly and efficiently. Since experts have already experienced many rough situations in life, they will know how to make decisions that will benefit us in the best way. Furthermore, in the course of the path with an expert guiding you, you will learn a lot of things that will help you make better choices. Finally, you will avoid wasting a lot of your life's time trying to follow your own instincts and ideas.

The main reason I'd visit this place is because of the big castle there and the beaches with amazing food and the cabins they have on the beach. Everything in Mallorco seems like a good reason to go there.

The castle is the main attraction I would like to visit. One reason I'd like to visit it is because the castle used to belong to the king of Spain; the throne that he sat on is still there. The employees let you take pictures of the throne and even let you sit on it. Another reason I'd visit the castle is because I can go to the top of the castle and look all around Mallorco. It is better to do it at night because that's when all the colorful lights are turned on, which makes it look really beautiful. The final reason I'd visit it is because outside of the castle are musicians that perform songs to entertain people. They don't ask for tips, but you can still give them money. There are also fountains that are huge and spill water out.

Near the castle is a beach where people can go and make delicious food. One of the most popular dishes there is corn with a hot sauce called tajin on it. They put the corn on a stick, put mayonnaise on it, and put then put tajin on it. It is one of the most delicious things you would ever taste. They make another snack called empinadas. This is a traditional snack in Mallarco. They put caramel and chocolate inside of it and put sugar on top. They look like a half moon with the edges cut off. While you're eating your snacks

you can watch professional divers jump off a cliff into the ocean. They do flips, spin around, etc. They do a competition to see who does better and the crowd judges. After all of this is done you can rent a cabin on the beach and sleep there. The cabin has a window that lets you see the ocean once you wake up. You can stay in this cabin until your trip is over.

Mallorco is the place that I would like to visit. They have an amazing castle that lets me see all of Mallorco and delicious food thats comes with entertainment and a cabin you can sleep in. These all seem like good reasons to visit Mallorco.

Author Ralph Waldo Emerson once said, "Success isn't around the corner. You'll have to work as hard as you can until you reached your limits. Always trying new things will make you grow." Life can be great, if you know how to make the best out of it. Although, it may seem that trying is hard and it's a waste of time, it is actually true that trying can make you achieve your goals.

Trying my hardest showed me who I really am. I accomplished some of my goals, but I always try to be inspired. This helped me get through my problems. None of my goals have been easy, they're hard, but that doesn't stop me. My plan is to be successful in life and not to be a failure. Sometimes I loose and sometimes I win.

I used to be 275 pounds, I wasn't happy with the way I looked. I also experience random pain in my heart. My body was telling me to start loosing weight. I really wanted to go and loose all of my weight, but my lazy side said to just sit in the couch and play video games all day. I had to get my life together and started going to the gym, the following day. Day by day, I started to feel something different. I felt more energetic and strong. I ate healthy and those heart pains were gone. My parents were always there for me to encourage me. I also wanted to be an example to my little brother that anything is possible, as long as you try.

I lost 58 pounds to be exact. I feel lighter than ever. I went beyond my limits to accomplish my goal. All hard work always rewards you as it did for me. My reward was having cheat days. I always love cheat days because you can forget about your diet for a day and eat whatever you want. Cheat days are the best to have, but not all the time. You can loose track and fall.

Accomplishments are hard to achieve, but it's a lot of fun to do them. They can make you a better person and makes your life so much easier. As long as you try your best, you can do anything. My grandpa told me that trying is your best buddy. It can make you push yourself and it can take you places you've never seen in your life.

Thomas Jefferson, writer of the Declaration of Independence and founding father of the United States, once said, "Determine never to be idle...it is wonderful how much may be done if we are always doing." In Jefferson's eyes, a world spent in constant work and motion represents a more productive and accomplished world. However, there is merit in a world that does not work without break and resolves to be idle at times. A world that is always working may also be a world that is burning out, diminishing the value of building connections and reflecting. A world that is idle when it recognizes its need to be has more value than a world that is always working, as it allows time for cognitive development and reflection, mental health, and inspiration.

In the body, the brain represents an entity that is constantly developing, creating new ideas, and planning for the future. If a human was always working, there would be no time to create new ideas or plan. The potential of the human brain would reduce, as the human brain would never have the time to step back and reflect on its past experiences and how it wants to reflect lessons learned from those experiences in the future. For example, if Thomas Jefferson had not taken time off to create new ideas and plan for his country before writing the Declaration of Independence, the United States would be very different from the way it is today. Every idea would be thought of on the spot, and the potential ramifications and consequences of each idea would not be carefully taken into consideration. In addition, the human brain requires breaks to keep working, just as the human body needs sleep to continue on the next day in a healthy state. Time spent idle does not equal time spent wasted; time spent idle is time spent reflecting, planning, and developing. Time spent being idle carries the potential to be a valuable learning experience to the human life, as well. In colleges, the requirements for acceptance do not only include academic excellence - they also include extracurriculars and attention to when the brain needs a break. If students did not take time off to develop, their potential for achievement in life would reduce. Therefore, a world spent constantly working does not always represent a world of accomplishment.

Some argue that if one is not always working, then one cannot accomplish as much as one can, as a minute spent idle could lead to a day spent idle, and so on. Contrastingly, if one is always working, then one has a much greater risk of crashing. Mental health is an essential reason as to why the world today does not and cannot constantly work as Jefferson wants it to. Many studies show that top students in classes, those who never stop working towards their goals, can have a greater risk of developing depression, anxiety, or addiction to drugs. This is because their brains cannot comprehend the constant work, and moves to other unhealthy tactics of releasing emotions. Several stories in the world detail the downfall of the most intelligent people, simply because the never took a break for themselves. Furthermore, if one's life is spent constantly working, one's brain is exposed to extreme competition and high standards. These two concepts are unhealthy for the human brain, as one may believe that they actually are not working hard enough and need to work themselves even harder, when reality shows that they already work themselves unhealthily. This concept ties in with the concept of unhealthy comparison, which further proves why mental health is one of the largest reasons as to why the world cannot constantly work. Those who always work also always compare themselves to others who are working, and often times do not take into account that what they are doing is very unhealthy. All of these concepts combined greatly heighten the chance in the deterioration of mental health. A world spent working constantly is a world exposed to bad mental health.

Finally, if the world is spent constantly working, then there is no time for inspiration of any sort. If one's brain is constantly in a working state, it will never spend time appreciating the beauty of the world around it and taking in inspiration for future plans. A wise man once said, "Life never hands you anything, you always have to earn it yourself". We always need to work our way up to reach our destination. Self-esteem is our fuel that gives us the energy and confident to raise above. But where does it come from? Some people believe that self-esteem can be build by praise. The only source of self-esteem is formed from achievement because it shows our true potential and it motivates us to work hard.

True self-esteem comes from achievement because it shows us our true potential. For example, Generic_Name, my youngest sister, loves science. Two years ago, she participated in her school's science fair but only placed fifth in her class. She was very upset and started questioning her abilities. Her teachers tried to comfort her, but she never listens easily. The next year when science fair came around, she was well-prepared. She decided to do a topic on volcanoes. She researched for days and weeks to gain all the sources. She even created a model of a giant, live volcano. She placed second in her class and went to regional. After she had proved herself, she went on to test her potential. She decided to go on to even harder topics for next year. A study done by UVA's students showed that students become more confident after they achieve something their heart desires; they are more likely to push themselves to harder levels. They have a higher rate of getting out of their comfort zones and succeeding. The source of true self-esteem is achievement because it shows us our true potential.

True self-esteem comes from achievement because it motivates us to work hard. For example, one time in chemistry, we were playing Kahoot to prepare for our big test. I had been leading for the past two games, and my teacher along with my peers were giving me endless praise. I got caught up in the moment too much that I started slacking off. Eventually, I started falling from the leading chart and ended up placing ninth on the third game. In the next round, I did not listen to anyone and just focused on getting the questions right. I placed first again with a new high score. In 2014, a group of students from UCLA were put under an experiment. They were given an AHL test with fairly easy questions. After the test, they were divided into two teams; the team who scored higher was praised highly for their efforts while the other team was given their results back without any response. Next week, another test was given to both of the teams with even harder questions. Each of the students took longer to finish. The results in the end showed that the team that was not praised for their first test had scored 40% higher than last time. While the team that was praised had a drop of 30% in their test scores. The team with higher test scores the first time slacked off like me after being praised for their efforts while the other team became determined to work hard. Our achievements give us a boost in our self-esteem and motivation to work hard.

Achievement is the only source of true self-esteem. It shows us our true potential and it persuades us to work hard. Some people believe in praising our work to build self-esteem, even if the work is not our best effort. However, praise given for deficient work undetermines learning by lowering standards. If our society treats us like fragile, glass paintings and in need of constant praise, we will turn into into weak and lazy adults.

Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; well-controlled text organization; precise use of grammar and conventions; rare language inaccuracies that do not impede communication.

## Score 4

Facility in the use of language with syntactic variety and range of words and phrases; controlled organization; accuracy in grammar and conventions; occasional language inaccuracies that rarely impede communication.

## Score 3

Facility limited to the use of common structures and generic vocabulary; organization generally controlled although connection sometimes absent or unsuccessful; errors in grammar and syntax and usage. Communication is impeded by language inaccuracies in some cases.

## Score 2

Inconsistent facility in sentence formation, word choice, and mechanics; organization partially developed but may be missing or unsuccessful. Communication impeded in many instances by language inaccuracies.

## Score 1

A limited range of familiar words or phrases loosely strung together; frequent errors in grammar (including syntax) and usage. Communication impeded in most cases by language inaccuracies.

Students are expected to identify a career by the time they enter high school. When students enter high school, they begin to work at a specific job to earn some money in order to be prepared for their future career.

It is not a good idea for students to commit to a specific career at a young age because it will cause distractions from school work, students are still getting education, and specific jobs will distract students from activities they enjoy.

Students should not commit to a career at a young age because it will cause distractions from school work. In high school, teachers and other faculties take education seriously and gets harder for students every year as they develop. Students get a lot of homework and tests they have to study for and need to focus on education in order to graduate from high school and get to a good collage. Spending time on a specific job before their actual career can distract students and decrease their grades. For example, a high school student goes to work at a salon after school but they have so much homework and a test to be prepared for, but they have don't have enough time to study and accomplish their homeworks since their specific job is in the way. So they begin to get a low grade and fail tests, which can also give them a low self-esteem.

Students should not commit to a career at a young age because are still getting education. High school students are still young and are still developing, they need to spend their high school years to study and get a good education in order to develop. In their high school years, students begin to get an idea of what they wish to be for their future career, so they are still learning about it and that's how they get a better amount of money, be well-educated, and live a good and healthy life. For example, high school student is not well-educated and is still developing, so they need to keep studying and learning in school to graduate and get to a good collage to study about their future career that interests them and the dream job they are wishing to work for. A specific career will take them away from their dream job.

Students should not commit to a career at a young age because specific jobs will distract students from activities they enjoy. It is important for students to do activites they enjoy to be healthy and have something positive and enjoyable to do. When they get a specific job during their high school years, it will take them away from these enjoyable and positive activities they and will have no time to do it when they have a specific career and school, which can also cause stress for students and will never find anything positive that they enjoy to do. For example, a student plays football and really enjoys it and it gives them positive energy. But they have to go to school and need time to do their schoolwork and study to pass. When they get a specific job, they don't have time to do their favorite activity and also not have enough amount of time to study and do schoolwork, which can cause stress to students.

In conclusion, students should focus on studying and education in high school and not get a specific career that will distract themselves from school or any activities they enjoy to just to get money. They have to keep developing and study hard to get to a good collage and be prepared for their dream job to get a good amount of money and live a better life.

Who is someone you look up to? How has their shared wisdom and experiences helped you? One person who has shared their wisdom and experiences with me is my dad. He has helped me make the right choice based on his experiences. It is important to learn from the experiences of others because their experiences can prevent you from making mistakes, their stories can help you make choices, and their tips can put you at an advantage.

The experiences of others can prevent you from making mistakes by someone telling you about the mistakes they have made. By telling you about the mistakes they have made, they can help you know about what not to do. For example, when I was learning how to ride a bike without training wheels, my dad told me a story about how he let go of the handles and crashed when he was learning how to ride a bike. After he told me that story I never let go of the handles and I didn't crash. My dad's story helped me learn about mistakes I shouldn't make.

People's experiences can help you make choices by sharing their stories about your different options. Someone's experience of the choice you have to make can help you decide on what is right for you. One example is about the time I had to choose between two camps, a cooking camp and a basketball camp. My dad had been a councilor at each camp and he told me about the camps' activities and what the atmosphere was like. His stories about each camp aided me in choosing the right camp. When someone shares their experiences about the choices that you have to make, they can steer you in the right direction.

Someone's experiences can put you at an advantage because they can give you extra information. When your about to go on a similar path as someone did they can give you tips so that you can have a good experience. An example of this is when I had a babysitting interview for a family and I was nervous. My dad was a babysitter when he was younger, so he gave me tips on how to please the family and how to find interest of their kids. The tips he gave me aided me in getting the job, and now I am the family's official babysitter. The tips that my dad told me, gave me an advantage in the interview. People's experiences can boost your odds and give you advantages.

Think about the person you look up to. How have their shared mistakes, advantages, and stories guided you in the right direction? My dad shared his experiences with me so that I could have good experiences and make good choices. It is important to learn from the experiences of others so that you can prevent mistakes, make the right decisions, and get boost your odds.

Should School Extend Two More Hours To The Normal Schedule?

One topic that is frequently debated is whether school should extend the day schedule or keep a normal schedule as they have it already. Some people think that school should not expend two more hours to our normal schedule. They feel that if we spend two more hours at school, it will be boring and tired. In my opinion, school should extend two more hours to our schedule for many reasons: I can spend more time to learn in classes, spend more time with friends, and work one more day during the week.

Once, I was pretty nervous about my Earth Science SOL test, I did not know what to do to pass it because I never passed any quiz or test that we did during the school year, and I felt worried because I did not understand some topics, and I only had one week to learn everything, so I decided to stay everyday after school to practice with my teacher and by myself at home, after a couple days of practicing I realized that I had learned what I needed to learn and I felt ready to take my SOL and finally, I passed it. Now I know that spending more time in classes helps us to understand what we do not understand yet, learn more about the topics that we are practicing in class, and get ready for any test that we have during the semester.

Sadly, I am a Senior, and this is my last year in High School, and that means that maybe, I will not see some friends and teachers again, so I am trying to enjoy everyday in the school expending time with friends and teachers whether during lunch or during classes, and I think that spending at least 25 more minutes with them in every class will help us to know more about each other, and to make more experiences to remember after we graduate from High School.

As some students, I do not have a permanent job or an everyday job as some people call it, I work for a moving and storage company, and that means that I can only work Saturdays and sometimes Sundays because I come to school and they ask me to be ready in the company at 7:00 am when I am going to work, but having a free day school during the week would benefit me because I would be able to work one more day during the week, and earn extra money to buy something that I might need.

As you have read, I am agree about extend the school day two more hours. Only when we realize that spending more time at school would helps us to learn easier, make a lot of experiences with friends and teachers, and gives us a free day school to work, to do homework, to spend time with family, or do some chores at home, the world will be a better place with students that understand what they need to understand about their classes, and people who takes advantage of at least one day free per week.

Can you believe that on average 60% of students do not participate in an after school activity? I know I can, I'm apart of that 60%. Can you also believe that the principal has decided that all students must participate in at least one extracurricular activity? Now this is unbelievable, many students, including myself, are extremely busy and simply don't have time to stay after school. It's hard trying to juggle schoolwork, social life, family life, and personal problems, let alone adding one more ball to your juggling circus act by staying after school. I know that staying after school and participating in extracurricular activities can have many benefits, like finding new interests and making new friends, but many students don't have the possibility to stay after school due to their busy schedules. I completely disagree with the principal that all students must participate in at least one extracurricular activity due to the fact that some students are busy and don't have time, others participate in other activities outside of school, and it would cost the school more money to fund the activities.

One reason why I disagree with the principal about staying after school is that many students don't have the opportunity to stay after school due to them being busy outside of school. Many students have commitments and responsibilities outside of school, such as going to work,or taking care of a younger sibling, which serve as an impediment and prohibits the student from staying after school. If these students were demanded by the principal that they have to stay after school, then these students would end up losing not only their jobs, but the trust and responsibilities their bosses and parents have put for them as well. Many students do not like the idea of staying after school due to the fact that it would cause more stress on them by trying to keep up with school, work, after school, family life, etc. From all the stress they would be receiving it could cause a toll on their mental health as well as their physical health, and could cause them to do poorly in school, as well as in other areas of their life. I know parents would not want this for their children, and would not want for them to risk their jobs, responsibilities, and especially their health all for an extra activity after school that they are too busy for.

Like the students who are busy, there are many students that can not participate in an extracurricular activity after school because they are already participating in other activities outside of school. Many students participate in sports, where they are in a club or league and they have to make it to practice or compete in tournaments after school. Other students go to academies for tutoring so they can get extra help in school, or to enhance their learning and advance in their studies. Some students also participate in different programs offered by the community, such as Girl Scouts, Boy Scouts, Girls and Boys Club, music programs, environmental programs,etc. Typically these programs have meetings almost everyday which members of these clubs have to attend. In many cases students are in more than one of these activities after school that take up almost all their time, and therefore they cannot commit to any more after school activities.

Not only would staying after school for an extracurricular activity affect the students, but it would also affect the school as well as the school's budget due to the fact that the school will need to spend more money to fund all of the activities. The more sports and activities the school offers and needs to add to fit everyone in at least one activity, the more the school will have to spend on adding activities as well as any equipment needed for those activities. Not to mentions with all these activities we need experienced teachers and coaches to assess with all the students and run the activities. With teachers having to stay after school they would have to get paid for those extra hours they have worked. You also have to take into consideration transportation. How are the students going to get home after school? Many parents are still busy working and might not have time to pick their child up, others might not even have a car. Yes, you can get enough buses to transport everyone back home, but more after school buses means spending more money on drivers and buses. With all this money being spent for after school there won't be enough money to spend and fund activities for the actual school day, which in my opinion more important than after school.

In conclusion, I disagree with the principal that all students must participate in at least one extracurricular activity because some students are busy and don't have time, others participate in other activities outside of school, and it would cost the school more money to fund activities. The principal needs to take into consideration these reasonings and consider the viewpoints and opinions of students, staff, and administrators to change their decision on making everyone stay after school, and instead change their proposal so it can fit everyone's needs.

Character traits are the way people behave.

Character traits can be inherited from people we surround ourselves with, like familiy and friends, but that does not mean that we have to be like them.

Anyone can choose their own character traits because everyone is different.

People have different personalities, manners, and behviors.

People have their own personalities. Some may be shy and others outgoing.

For example, little kids are shy when they are around people they do not know.

Most parents do not like when their kids are shy because they start to whine and act anti-social. Meanwhile, when they are at home they have a party of their life.

As kids grow up though, they begin to be a bit more outgoing.

They start to communicate and socialize more.

As kids grow up they are taught certain manners.

Parents start to educate them at home.

They may teach them basic manners like to say "please" and "thank you", greet people, share with others, etc. Parents teach their kids to be respectful but sometimes kids choose do otherwise.

For example, a little kid playing with someone else and all of a sudden they start to fight, not wanting to share their toys.

Kids may choose to do so because of their age or the stage they are going through.

When kids grow up they behave different.

They learn new things and view things from a different perspective.

They change from being childish to maturue, like teenagers.

At a teenage stage they may want to be independent.

Teenagers may still not listen to their parents.

They begin to make their own decisions and choose their own lifestyle.

For example, wanting to drive on their own, dressing however they want to, etc.

In conclusion, people choose their own character traits no matter their age, how they are raised or what they are taught.

Our charcater traits are not formed by influences beyond our control.

We choose how to act, what to do, and what not to do.

Overtime, people do change but still choose their own character traits.

We do not have to be like people we surround ourselves with.

One of the greatest artist, Michelangelo said "The greatest danger in life isn't aiming too high and falling short, but aiming to low and achieving your goal". I find this statement really important because it's true in many ways. Working hard and falling short can get you close to your goal, aiming short is easier but that's not what you really wanted, and you'll never know how high you would of gone if you tried hard enough. I belive that

Michelangelo's statement is true.

To begin with, aiming high and falling short is okay because at least you were putting effort in to achieving your goal. That just mean that working a bit harder would of got you to your achievement. I once worked on my final exams for my science class and aimed for a high score but failed by one point, then I took it again and passed with enough work and determination. So take your best shot and don't be afraid to fail.

Next, I belive that there's no short-cuts in life. That's why having low goals is completely pointless and won't get you anywhere. Wouldn't you want to make something good out of your life and be happy? Getting up and trying to reach high goals won't hurt you, the worse thing that could happen is failing but that shouldn't hold you down, the only thing to hold you down is yourself for not trying. So get up and shoot for high goals.

Thirdly, the one thing that I really hate is when people say "I wouldn't have made it anyways". How would you know if you would of reached your goal if you never even tried? It's impossible to know if you don't give it a go, a person doesn't become the best in their line of work or ability without trying, failing, repeat, and finally succeed. I never thought that I would ever be a good athlete until I practiced hard and started getting better. Aim high and try to reach your destination, but never aim low and be somewhere that you don't really want to be.

Finally, these are my reasons to why I agree with Michelangelo in his quote. I understand why others may disagree with my beliefs, they might say that you control your life and how it works. This may be true,but as long as you don't give up on your goals you can be anything.

influences. In the early centuries China exerted dominion over Vietnam and hence many lonwords from Chinese still exist in current Vietnamse, especially for cuultural and econmic terms. The French Jesuit Missionaries in the 17th century further developed the language with the introduction of a Roman script to facilita their efforts to evangelize the Vietnamese to Catholicism. Hence the current script has much of Sino-Vietnamese words (influence from Chinese), Thai and Khmer words (influence from the neighboring countries) and French/Latin/Portuguese (influence from the Jesuit mis-ionarise).

Asking many people for their opinions can be more tiresome than just asking one person, but it has it's benefits. You'll be well and truly informed about the pros and cons of each side, thus meaning you won't be biased when it's time to make your decision. You also get many points of views and the chance to realize things that you wouldn't have noticed with only asking one person. You also will be able to identify fabricated or exaggerated opinions more easily and separate them from the real opinions.

In order to be truly informed, you must know both the pros and cons of each side. To acquire information about both sides, you must go around asking others for their opinions and such, because nobody's perfect, to each their own when it comes to mindset. Not everyone will have the same information about a side. For example, a person may know a con about a side, but another person may know a pro about the same side. If you had not asked the second person. You may not have known about the pro on the same side. By asking many people for their opinions, you'll have a less chance of making a bias decision if you are well and truly informed.

Point of view also plays an important role in making a decision. People may see things that you may not have noticed right away. When asking many people, you get not only their advice and opinions, but their point of view. Their point of view explains why they are on a side. Their point of view can be used to connect certain pieces of advice to other pieces of advice or opinions, slowly creating the bigger picture. When the picture is complete, you will be able to make your decision.

Asking many people can also counteract the problem that arises when you only ask one person for advice or their opinion. The problem is that people are not honest at times. A study shows that 73% percent of people questioned have made and kept a lie to this day. The same study shows an estimated 15% of those who said they haven't kept a lie are ironically lying. If you were to only ask one person for their opinion as opposed to many, you would have an estimated 88% to get a exaggerated, if not a completely fabricated response. If you asked many people, you would have a set of data you can rely on. You would be able to separate the fabricated or exaggerated opinions and advice because they would look like outliers compared to the rest.

In conclusion, it's better, safer, and more secure to ask many people for their different points of view, opinions, and advice. By asking many people as opposed to one, you can separate the fabricated or exaggerated opinions from the real ones. You can also find out both the pros and the cons of each side. That allows you to paint the bigger picture and make a truly, well informed decision, and you dont have to be worried about having made a biased decision.

Imagine if the world was overrun by zombies, and you just created a vaccine that could save humanity. Unfortunately, it comes at the price of the lives of your companions. Maybe this vaccine won't save humanity, but change it for the worse. Would you sacrifice your friends for the sake of future generations, or just let the zombies thrive as you and your squad live in peace? Alright, most everyday decisions will not be this burdensome, but it's nice to ask for advice before making one. Seeking multiple opinions of others can help someone make a better choice because that person gets to view other perspectives, they can help find both the positives and the negatives of a specific choice, and it encourages the person that he or she made a good decision.

Having other perspectives on possible consequences can undoubtedly change an outcome, since more than 75% of humans tend to be opinionated when making a decision. For example, let's say that you absolutely despise a band called BTS because their music is in a language you do not understand. A fan of them may go up to you and explain how you don't need to understand what language they speak to know the message they give in their songs. That fan just suggested something you never thought of. Now that you've obtained a new perspective, you then realize that even though you don't understand Korean, their newest title track talks about how they're not afraid to face the pain and and suffering that they will experience. As you can see, ideas may be absurd at first, but they can be meaningful when you go over it.

"There's beauty in everything, but not everyone sees it." This is a quote from Park Jimin. It states that everything has a positive side to it, as well as a negative one, just not everyone can see it all at once. It applies to humans like you and I. Just like how other people can offer their perspectives that you never considered, they can also pass on pros and cons of what that choice will bring. If you were given the chance to travel to a foreign country with all expenses paid for, except the place you're going is known for the amount of criminals and gangs that reside within that area, would you still visit? Instead, you asked your friend who tells you that when they visited that place, their hotel room was broken into, and they had no choice but to cancel the rest of the trip and go back home. Without knowing the negative experience your friend had gone through, you may have put yourself in danger of becoming another victim of a scam!

Like I've stated before, most everyday decisions are not very burdensome, unless you're an over thinker like myself. Maybe you just need reassurance with the final decision you're making. If your old phone broke, you decided that its time to get a new one. You're still unsure about investing in a new phone, so you ask your parents. Since they approved of your choice, as well as give you tips on which one you should buy, you feel confident that you're making a wise decision for yourself.

You don't realize how beneficial it is to work together on something until you experience that teamwork. You can even learn from them too. It can be hard at first, but asking for advice goes a long way. Other people and their opinions can even influence what you become in the future. At least for now, they can help you choose wiser decisions for yourself by providing insight and help for whatever it is you need.

I have three reasons why I agree with the former British Prime Minister Winston Churchill's statement. First of all, the reason why I agreed with the former Prime Minister Winston Churchill's statement was because, if you have never experienced failure, it just means you havent tried anything new in your life. Another reason, why I agreed with the former British Prime Minister Winston Churchill's statement would be because, that it takes dedication and commitment to get back up after failing. Last reason why why I agreed with the former British Prime Minister Winston Churchill's statement was because, if failing didn't exist people wouldn't have learned anything from their past failures.

First of all, if you have never experienced failure, it just means you haven't tried anything new in your life. Once you try something new, you're going to at least fail once or maybe twice, depending on what you're trying to gain. In conclusion, I agree with the former British Prime Minister Winston Churchill's statement. I have three reasons why . First of all if you havent failed at anything, that just means you havent tried anything new. Another reason why I agreed is because to gain something you need dedication and commitment. Last reason why is because if failing didnt exist how would people learn their lessons after their failure. These are my three main reasons why I agreed with the former British Prime Minister Winston Churchill's statement.

There are different ways to accomplish a task. There may be more ideas by working in a group; however, working alone is more beneficial. Working alone is more beneficial because there is no distraction, it will be faster, and there's no need to think twice.

First, working alone is more beneficial because there is no distraction. Group work are always crowded. For example, in my Biology class, my teacher assign a group to all the students. All groups were made of four (4) people. My group was made with only funny people. They were funny at the point that I could not stop laughing when the teacher is talking. I laughed all class. At a moment I remember why I was in school, so I cool down myself when it was time to work. If a student who love distractions was put in the group I was in he/she will not do something until the end of class. He/she will just be coming to class just to have fun and not to study. It's ok having fun in class, but he/she must have fun at the right time. Also, any time I work alone, I am more focus because I don't have to talk to anyone when I am working. There's no distraction when a person work alone.

Second, working alone is more beneficial because it will be more faster. Some people do not understand things in class, so they need someone to explain to them. For example, the teacher give a topic to work on, and they are in total of four (4)

in the group. Only one (1) student understood the topic, but the other three (3) students need help, it will be now the duty of that one student to explain to his/her group members. If he/she was working alone, the time he/she will take to explain to his/her group members, he/she may be half way to the end of the work. A group work may be really slow or really fast, it depends of the people in the group. But for sure working alone will be fast. It will be fast because once he/she understand the work, he/she do not need to tell someone what he/she understood. For a faster work, working alone is more beneficial.

Finally, working alone is more beneficial because there's no need to think twice. The good thing about working in a group is that everybody wants to share his/her idea about the topic. But the negative side of this good thing is the fact of choosing from everybody s' idea without hurting someone's feeling. I've worked in a group before where there is girl that wanted her idea to be in the project by force. That cause some conflicts at the end. By working alone he/she just need his/her own ideas to make his/her work a success. A person who works alone do not need to ask someone's idea about what he/she is doing, but in a group he/she need everyone's agreement before going forward. After a reflection a person who is working alone just go to the next thing, but in a group, after a personal reflection they all need to bring their ideas together before moving to the next level. Working alone is more beneficial because there's no need to think twice.

In conclusion, working alone is more beneficial because there's no distraction, it will be faster, and there's no need to think twice. By working alone he/she do not have to deal with the reactions of people around him/her, he/she work at his/her tempo, and he/she express his/her own ideas. All in all, working alone is more beneficial and the best.

Setting good examples by people's good behavior marks the sign as an excellent impression amongst other people out there. People's mesmerizing personality traits are expressed in many ways that every other person would wish to have. Although there may be better ways to influence people, setting good examples by good behavior is the alternative approach since people are more ambitious towards achieving their own personal goals without getting influenced through another crowd of people or becoming a better person in general.

Students at school are overcoming their own mental challenges through self- esteem. One shy girl who dresses awkwardley, contains acne on her face, and the "nerd" of her entire school focuses on her assignments being given to her without any distractions. She is very negligent about the unpleasant comments other people in the school say about her. Role models in school strive to be superior amongst all students to show that over achievers are excelling with their education. An attractive guy who plays football and stays consistent with his schoolwork is disciplined and would never get caught up with all of the petty and ignorant others. Some athletes or even "attractive athletes" want to pursue their own personal goals to get where they want to be.

Employees and their bosses put their time and effort towards making decent amount of money to provide for their families. In the field of dentistry, Dentists constantly work hard to ensure that their own patients are receiving outstanding treatments and informing them about how important it is to brush and floss their teeth twice a day. Patients admire graceful dentists who care and knows what is best for people when it comes to any conflicted situation. Waiters or waitresses who work at restaurants attempt to impress people who are dining and meet customer's needs. Their goal is to help the business succeed because they want customers to have a joyous experience.

Yes people can advocate for others who have different standards than their own and have them transform into being the person they were destined to become or focusing what matters more in life. However, finding solutions towards the opposite path can help build a stronger motive. A swimmer who was caught up with all of the petty drama her friends started, decided not to be part of it anymore when all of her swim races were horrendous. Instead, she wanted to worry about herself and her own progress by not only becoming good at what she does, but also a better role model. A student who fails a test will feel like their life is distraught and depressing after working hard at what they did, but finds a solution to thrive and not struggle anymore. Not giving up entirely is the key to achieving the grade they want and having better outcomes.

Whether it is striving to become a better person or achieving what everybody wants without any distractions, those are some good examples that people set out for the world to see. Good examples are intended to help people with lower standards or self-esteem and realize that the people who are succeeding, never took part in anything bizarre and distracting that could potentially harm their personalized ambitions in the first place. They show how being a good person with outstanding morals are determined to thrive.

A good example is set by a good character. We cannot be recognized to be a good example for others if our character differs from the qualifications of a good example. When one's

actions are recognized within a society, others want to live by his/her good deeds. A few are remembered and honored in our societies today because they lived to set an example for everyone. Setting a good example is the only way to influence other people because people are going to learn from our example, and succeed from our example.

Setting a good example is the only way to influence other people because people are going to learn from our example. For example, when we do good to others, they are going to follow suit of our actions. One day as my friend and I walked through the busy streets of NewYork, we came across a homeless father and son. They had told us that they had not eaten for one and half days. At that moment, I had nothing but a twenty dollar bill that I had saved to buy myself a new pair of shoes that cost $14. As the young child looked at me with sorrowful and merciful eyes, I reach out to my wallet and took out the twenty dollar bill a handed it to them. As they rejoiced in gladness, they hugged us and went off to buy themselves a flourishing lunch. Later that day, from a distance, I saw the same homeless father and son helping another homeless adult with money to buy food. I was gland to see this because I knew someone learned from my good deed. I really could not tell how much money they gave him, but I know it was enough to buy enough food for an adult. In fact, many people who do good deeds for others, learn from other people who did good to them or form someone else. Therefore, the best way to influence others is by setting a good example for them to follow.

Setting a good example is the only way to influence others because others are going to succeed from our example. It may seem easy to succeed in life because of one's actions, but it is not. For example, when a young boy named Generic_Name was admitted to Generic_School, he came with a goal to become a good example for all at his new school. He was very energetic and and friendly to all. During his classes, he made sure to help the students who did not understand the teacher's explanation. One day as he was helping with some students in his math class, Generic_Name, one of his classmates, came to him and asked him how he was able to understand much from the teacher so quickly and be willing to explain it to the struggling students. Without any doubt of his actions, Generic_Name replied to him that he works so hard to completely understand what the teacher taught in order to come and give additional help to those who did not understand. His fellow classmate was satisfied by that answer, but he felt incomplete. Generic_Name also learned that Generic_Name's grades were always pleasing. It was not long when Generic_Name joined him in his mission to set a reliable example. After Generic_Name formed a coalition with Generic_Name, his grades were satisfying. 60% of people who succeed in life are those who set aside their interests and set a good example for others to follow. In conclusion, we should be willing to set a good example for others find their sense of doing good for others.

Setting a reliable example is the only solution to influence others. People are going to learn from our actions, and succeed from our them. Others may argue that people with bad characters can set a good example. However, it is nearly impossible for someone whose character is unreliable to set a good example. People are not going to learn from how we wear, or how much we have, but from how we act and live.

In my opinion i don't think it's a bad idea, I think everyone could be able to finish high school in three years due to the fact that we don't necessarily need elective classes, but unfortenently in all high schools you have to take electives because it all counts as credits, unless you take more main courses.

High school was meant to be the last four years before you become an adult, so you get to prepare for the real life and learn to be responsible of yourself. Many people do not agree with the topic of graduating early because they want to enjoy all four years and create memories. Go to football and basketball games, join after school clubs, be in a leadership class, run for senior president, etc. Teenagers want to enjoy there years being in high school by doing the most they can, but unlike for others who don't really do anything all of there four years eventually get bored and you will mostly likely hear "i just wanna be done with school" or " when is this going to be over" come out of there mouth.

High school for me is the definition of stressful but fun at the same time it's because i participate in clubs and go to football games but at the same time i do all my work, turn everything in on time but when its time for report cards its stressful trying to bring your grades up. I am an AB student, and if i wanted to i could've took extra online courses to graduate earlier but i wanted to enjoy the rest of my years, some teenagers do it because they already have their future's plan out and know what college and what career they want to pursue so they try to graduate high school in three years by taking summer school for that one extra class you need.

Everyone has there opinion on it and i dont think theres nothing wrong with graduating early i think its off personal liking or if its necessary

In conclusion being in high school is great, you learn a lot not just from being in school but from becoming a responsible person etc, i couldn't really pick a side to this argument because its based off of someones liking and preference whether they have their futures planned out or needing a little extra time to do so and i think thats where that fourth year of high school comes in, the fourth year is where most counselors help you by starting to apply to colleges or helping you find the path to it, like i said most people can graduate in three years, its possible for everyone by not taking so many electives and taking a few online courses and thats for people who want to do so,well in my opinion if you need extra time to know what your gonna do after high school i suggest you don't go to the path of graduating in three years so enjoy them.

Some schools even have internships that students get paid from. Some schools assign students their projects to assure, that they continue learning during their break. Most students fail to continue to learn because they have their own personal plans to accomplish during their summer break. But, some students fail to do it because the projects were given from their previous teacher, that they have already had and they do not want to work for them again. Although, summer projects should be student-designed.

Teachers can evaluate students' weaknesses and give them projects based on what they need, for their own practice and revision session during the break. Teachers should assign project about the course, that they have already completed for more revision and for more details about it. For example, i already completed the earth science course on my freshmen year but, for more details and information about the topic that we discussed, our teacher gave us the project about the climate change and the impact on the environment, during the summer time, so that we can be productive and visualize in our break. Teacher-designed projects are more reliable because the teacher can choose a specific topic for the students' requirement. Some students are naive, they can't come up with a topic and they end up not doing it. Of course, many students will probably disagree on student-designed projects, and claim that teacher-designed topics are way better. However, every person has an interest on doing something or every person have a hobby. Moreover, students should be able to decide on what they desire to work on from their own interest or describe about their hobby, writing an essay.

Students should be self-reliance of themselves because self-reliance is the key to success. They should not depend on anyone else, but their heart and the way how they think, that will bring accomplishments to their lives. I understand that teachers are responsible of giving the best topics for students to work on, but i believe that, students have followed all the directions of the teacher, during the entire school-year, but in a long break, it should be the opposite. Teachers should allow students to think of their own and come up with a topic ,and write what they have learned from the teachers. Student-designed projects will help them research about topics and, it will benefit them for the future. It will help them think independently. It will allow them to choose their desired topic and work on their own will. I managed to pick a topic that i desired, eventually, i completed my project researching and thinking about the topic on my own because i was able to elaborate it myself, since i got to choose the desired topic i want, but some of my classmates had a hard time by only researching because they chose the topic from the board. For example, when you go to the museum, there is lot to visualize and learn from it. Self-designed projects would be complicated for some students, but most importantly, research and your effort, is required. Self-designed projects are very beneficial because it helps you to work as an independent individual. Furthermore, you will gain the way how you think, both physically and mentally.

it is more convenient for both students and the teacher. Visualization would be an easy hint for the student to work on their project. Do we accomplish more things when doing something, or does inactivity also serve a purpose?

Thomas Jefferson wrote, "Determine never to be idle... it is wonderful how much may be done if we are always doing something," I think we accomplish more if we are always doing something, simply for the fact that in your daily: typical life, you need to be active at school, your job, even in sports..

Being active is always a good thing but usually benefits you more at a young age, especially if you're going to school. Doing something serves a purpose in school because you have to get up, go to school, and also be active in class with assignments. You also have to come home and do your homework to further your knowledge even when you aren't in school. The more you are active in school the least likely you are to fall behind. Being inactive and not doing enough can make you critical in missing assignments, tests, and homework. This by itself can result in bad grades and bad test scores

Although doing more in school is it important, Being active and doing more at your job is just as important. If you're always working, staying focused, and not being inactive, that by it's self will always make you successful at your job. The negatives of you not doing enough can result in you losing your job because you aren't doing what you committed for. There are several ways to make sure you are always doing something and making sure your active at your job. Coming in on time, to show that you are working. Taking another shift, shows that you're focused and not being inactive. It shows your commitment to doing more, and how you're taking another shift to better yourself.

Additionally, Doing something in school and at your job is just two examples, of when doing something is needed. The last way is if you play a sport. Doing something for sports like, practicing, and even studying plays, helps you do something for the sport and yourself. Being inactive can result in you being out of shape, by not practicing and doing something. Studying plays outside of your sport is doing something and keeps you to not be inactive.

School, jobs, and sports are my ways to benefit yourself to doing something. Thomas Jefferson wrote, " Determine never to be idle... it is wonderful how much may be done if we are always doing."

Therefore i agree that more can be done by doing something then being inactive.

Some people believe that praising a student's work helps build their self-esteem, even if the work was not the best that the student could achieve. Others disagree and believe that in order to truly build self-esteem in students is through only their achievements. Although, I do understand why a students achievement may be the greatest source of building self-esteem. I believe that praising the amount of good work a student has done may actually better help them with their self confidence. Praising what they have done well does not mean a teacher can not constructively criticize their work. Praising a student for their efficient work may allow a student to be: more open to constructive criticism, makes room for improvement, and gives them more confidence to do better, when knowing what they did well and what needs more improvement.

Praising a student does not mean that the student can just get away with low work effort, the teacher can constructively criticize a student while still being able to recognize what they have done efficiently. With this, students will be more open to constructive criticism and will be more likely to ask for help when they need it. Being praised while also being criticized, in a matter of willing to help, may encourage the student to seek help when they need it. They will also become more aware of what they can achieve and to recognize where improvement is needed for themselves.

Praising a student's work, allows for teachers to gradually push their students to become better working students. Teachers can help their students by praising them for what they have done and informing them of what could be better. It creates room for improvement for the student and allows the student to show progress over time. A student may not be putting their best effort because they believe that they are not capable to amount to doing more than they believe they can.Others may also being doing less than what they can actually fulfill because others around them may have told them that they couldn't do any better.Their teachers may be at fault beacuase, if they are only telling them what they're doing wrong all the time which makes cause a student to lack effort. A teacher can help plenty with building a student's self esteem by recognizing the amount of effort they have done and the compelling work that they did achieve.

When a student doesn't put their best effort into their work, it may not just be because they're "lazy" , but, that they may have trouble understanding what they are doing

and may be too embarrassed to ask for help. This puts students in a disadvantage and may not be at their own fault. Their teacher must reassure them that they can ask for help whenever they need it and to let those, who are not finishing as fast as others, know that they are fine and they know that this students is doing their very best. Now, once the student is being praised for what they have done, then, this student may build up their confidence and want to do better to achieve greater things. They will be willing to think that they can improve and be willing to reach out for help if they need it.

Although a student's best achievements may improve their self-esteem, I believe that you can build their self-esteem with praising the little things that they have done which will lead those same students to improve more and more throughout time. A teacher, could lead their students to create better working habits by recognizing what they have done well and positively criticizing what they need improvement on without, having to only tell them everything that is wrong with their work. Praising a student's work , even if it isn't the best, allows room for growth and improvement to increasingly excel more in their work. This also builds self-esteem and confidence within a student and encourages them to improve and set larger goals that may lead them to achieve something greater. A student shouldnt be left in the shadows of those who achieve greater things just because they may have not done their best entirely. Those same students may have had a hard time with what they were doing or felt as if they can never do anything right. They should be praised for what they did do well on and be told that they can always do better in order to, truly build their self-esteem.

I remember that time, when we where just kids in the primary school. the teachers going crazy because of us and us getting always the grades what we wanted. those days in which just for sleeping, eating ad even playing you could get a good grade. all of these thoughts made me realize that maybe yes we had a good time when the teachers gave us good grades buy not doing hard work, but was that really the best way to teach us about the self-confident that we could eventually obtain by doing hard work and archiving good grades? which then lead me to think that having a student to do hard work and not pricing their grades would be the best way a teacher could help a student to obtain self-confidence.

In my opinion, when a teacher prices a student work, they are not making them a favor, because then the students are going to be used to get good grades for not giving their best. but in the other hand, when the teacher are a littler harder on the students, the students will eventually try to do their best for earning a good grade. which then, will be their achievement and they are going to do their best in future work, because they what to have or well, receive the same satisfactory feeling that they had when they got this good grade for first time, after a hard work.

On the other hand, I'm not saying that the teacher should be harsh on the students all the time. What I'm trying to say is that when the students are given a certain task to do, they are going to be even more proud of their grade if they know that they did a hard work to obtain it. For example, lets say that there are two students. Student A and student B. Student A, is used to do his homework in the last minute, they try to do everything they have to do together, without realizing if it is good or not, because eventually they know that without mattering if they try hard to o it they will receive a good grade. On the other hand, the Student B, who is very responsible and is a hard working student, doesnt get the same pricing work as the Student A. So these student works hard day and night to try to achieve this good grade that he wants to obtain.

Now if we look at both students, the Student A is not going to be as proud of his note as the Student B, because he knows that he didnt do his best to obtain this grade. which means that the Students A self-confident is not going to be as strong/good as the Student B, who had always tried his best, because in a future, where both students have to do something, the Student B is going to be more capable of doing these task because he is already used to do the jobs as good as possible for his own good.

In addition, I believe that the numbers or letters are not the ones that have to define a student. A student who always achieve the best grades is not always the better one, because in some cases, the better student is the one that might not have an A+, or a 100%, but is actually the one that can understand correctly a topic and tries to connect it to their daily life. The good student is not the one who only learns the different topics for the exam and having a good grade.

For concluding, we can affirm that making a student go through a hard learning process, and teaching them to do the hard work, will help them in the future to obtain a better self-confident in themselves, knowing that they are capable of doing different things well done, rather than thinking that the teachers could help them by adding extra points in their grades, knowing that they where not good enough for it.
